apps.name: LiveContainer Fork
apps.subtitle: LiveContainer with Shortcuts and screen broadcast for apps.
apps.localizedDescription: A fork of LiveContainer. Adds Shortcuts actions and screen broadcast for apps inside LiveContainer. Installs over LiveContainer and keeps your data. Includes the built-in SideStore.

versions.localizedDescription: App settings now have one App Extensions section with a switch for every feature, including Shortcuts. Features an app doesn't have are grayed out.

Adds Settings → Check for Updates and a check at launch. Each fork release now has its own version, so SideStore shows updates. Includes everything from 3.8.11.3: your apps' extensions run through LiveContainer.

Runs your apps' extensions through LiveContainer: share, actions, keyboard, Safari content blocker, Files, widgets and Live Activities, photo editing, iMessage, call blocking, SMS filter and screen broadcast. Keyboard, screen broadcast and SMS filter need permission per app. Updates no longer ask about app extensions.
Fixes the built-in SideStore's App Group error after installing from the source. The built-in SideStore's source is now this fork, so LiveContainer updates come from it.
First fork release, based on LiveContainer 3.8.11. Adds Shortcuts actions and screen broadcast for apps.
